structural_change: thin cluster: ot_qkvd_d2d's 11.5k own registers are hardened into pin-registered tiles with their own clock roots (ke_ti x3, ke_rq, ke_tm, ke_tf, ke_ro x4, ke_ctl: TT insertion 50-131 ps, spread <= 24 ps at the --cts gate) next to the pin-registered link buffers (sbufp x4, fbuf8p x3); the parent keeps ten W-face flops (reset synchroniser + fault face flops = the block's IO clock reference, balanced by the spine to the registers inside the children) and otherwise only distributes the clock to 18 child clock pins with entry offsets from the children's insertion.json (flat parents: qkd_d2d_ref-q10 TT -134.7 / FF -215.8 / DRC 35, qkd_d2d_pf_ref-q13 TT -129.5 / FF -141.6 / DRC 31, 11,497 registers on one root, boundary clock 2,072 ps TT); r_cr, tx_up and fault each one cycle later, everything else cycle-exact q17 (2026-10-14 split die): params QD 48/UCX 48 -> QD 8/UCX 64 (LINK.md: the KV end is the real link endpoint of the two-die split; only the children's cfg straps change); bench adds the full split link (native decode step, KVE_SPL 1, LLR).
